info.name: Narmi Public account balances mfa API

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

items.docs: List the authenticated user's MFA devices. All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents). For example, $10.00 is represented as 1000. How can we improve these docs? Share your feedback.

params.name: id
params.description: MFA device ID, constituted by a string of the device type followed by a device ID e.g. `otp_twilio.models.TwilioSMSDevice/1`.

items.docs: Delete a user's MFA device. All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents). For example, $10.00 is represented as 1000. How can we improve these docs? Share your feedback.

Retrieve information on whether the current user has sudo permissions. All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents). For example, $10.00 is represented as 1000. How can we improve these docs? Share your feedback.

Elevate user permissions using Two-Factor-Authentication. 



Send a `device_id` to generate and dispatch a one-time-password to the specified device. 



Send `device_id` and `one_time_password` to validate the OTP sent to a user. 



The endpoint will return a `403` if there is an issue with the `device_id` or `one_time_password`, or if the user has no registered 2FA devices.

All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents)
